name: BitLab Coin
description: BitLab Blockchain Security Spectrum is delivering Advanced Smart Contract Audit, Web3 Application Security & Development, Token Locker, Liquidity Locker, Token Security scanner, Blockchain Security & Development, Cybersecurity, Secure API, and more. BitLab Coin is the utility token of BitLab Blockchain Security Spectrum. The platform is designed for Crypto projects, web3 developers, Cybersecurity, and blockchain enthusiasts in general. The non-custodial Locker supports token, vesting, and liquidity locking across EVM networks and Solana, with public on-chain verification, permanent lock pages, flexible vesting models, forward-only unlock extensions, and so on. The locker supports token and liquidity locking across multiple chains such as Solana, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, Cronos, Base, Robinhood Chain, etc.  For projects seeking independent security validation, BitLab Advanced Smart Contract Security Audit combines manual and automated security review of smart-contract logic, source-code vulnerabilities, token mechanics and permissions, upgradeability, external dependencies, ownership/administrative controls, and common blockchain exploit vectors. Audits are designed for crypto tokens, wallet-related contracts, Token/LP Lockers, MEV contracts, automated trading bots, DeFi protocols, staking systems, launchpads, DAOs, and other blockchain-related smart contracts; with security checks covering logic and business-logic flaws, arithmetic issues, token manipulation, flash-loan, oracle risks, authentication/signature weaknesses, proxy, upgradeability risks, unsafe external calls, denial-of-service conditions, economic or tokenomic attack vectors and so on. BitLab's locker smart-contract implementations are publicly available in our white paper. The API service provides machine-readable locker status, liquidity-lock verification, security-score data, and other related data allowing third-party platforms to integrate BitLab directly into their own applications. At the same time, anyone can use the Free Token Security Scanner to evaluate a token address for potential risks and scam indicators, including mint and freeze authorities, buy/sell restrictions, honeypot-related behavior, contract permissions, holder concentration, liquidity conditions, token metadata, and available contract code. Together, these services position BitLab as a security-focused infrastructure platform for organizations seeking to improve security, transparency, investor confidence, and verifiable on-chain trust. We are the Security Layer of the blockchain & the web!
